cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved lunch with you in your haircut slot. You may rearrange the appointment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat later? I've had that booking for weeks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Later is not approved. We've been friends since school; I'd like to see us take precedence over your fringe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Changing it today costs twenty pounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The fee is authorized; I'll pay it. You may write lunch in that exact slot, in pen. I want to see that we can move something.
